title: Kernel construction and factorization API for local subobjects
statement: For a scheme X, an abelian pro-etale sheaf Q, a cover U [def-weil-pbc-proetale-covering], local sheaves L_i and maps q_i:L_i→Q|Ui, let α:Q→∏i(U_i→X)_*coker(q_i) have components adjoint to the cokernel projections. Define P=ker α and j its kernel inclusion. This actual construction is called localSubobjectKernel. If q_i are monic, construct the canonical local comparison P|Ui→L_i using the kernel-of-cokernel property. It is monic and commutes with the inclusions. Any map into Q locally factoring through each q_i factors through j. If q_i vanishes after the restricted α, the canonical comparison on Ui is an isomorphism.

source.place: Tag 04TR, effective gluing of sheaves, expressed for subobjects

proof.text: Use categorical cokernels, adjunction, products and kernels to construct α, P and j. No data are chosen from an unproved existence theorem.

Compose kernel.condition with each product projection and transpose along inverse-image/pushforward adjunction. The restricted j vanishes in each local cokernel, hence Abelian.monoLift produces the local comparison. Its composite with q_i is the restricted j, so it is monic.

If a map locally factors through all q_i, naturality of adjunction and cokernel.condition give zero composite with each component of α. Product extensionality and kernel.lift give the global factorization.

Weakly etale inverse image is localization restriction and preserves kernels. If q_i annihilates restricted α, kernel.lift produces the opposite local comparison. Cancel the two monomorphisms to prove the comparisons inverse.
